item.text: Genista anglica (petty whin, needle furze, or needle whin) is a shrubby flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). Native to Europe, it occurs in Cornwall, Wales, and eastern Scotland and grows up to 1 m tall. It thrives in moist, nutrient-poor soils but is susceptible to atmospheric nitrogen pollution.
